name: Embodied Question Answering
description: A benchmark task in which an agent navigates a 3D environment to gather first-person visual observations and answer questions about the scene.
citation: Das, A., Datta, S., Gkioxari, G., Lee, S., Parikh, D., and Batra, D. Embodied Question Answering. Confirmed arXiv 1711.11543. https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.11543
